structured.answer: The page points to Pesagot (פסגות) as the cheapest place, with the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)", ending at about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years on 70,000 ₪ put in, versus about 81–83 thousand at the big banks. But I don't know Pesagot or that fund well enough, so I'll ask my son or the bank before doing anything.
